daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo used his address to the MPR annual session to highlight government performance, including the growth of Pegadaian, while also unveiling plans for continued governance reforms. The Ministry of Defence confirmed it will establish two reserve component battalions in every district and city across Indonesia. Vice President inaugurated 76 Paskibraka members ahead of the Independence Day anniversary on 17 August.

  • DPR Deputy Speaker Sufmi Dasco stated that citizen safety is the priority following the NTT earthquake disaster.
  • Former Vice President Jusuf Kalla spoke at the 21st anniversary of Aceh peace, calling it a moment to build justice and prosperity, though the event was marred by clashes between crowds and security forces.
  • A DPR member called for all parties to exercise restraint following the Aceh Peace Day incident.
  • President Prabowo announced that social aid digitalisation has reached 153 districts and cities nationwide.
  • State Enterprise Minister said President Prabowo's SOE amnesty proposal aims to push governance reform in state-owned companies.
  • The Bogor City DPRD is accelerating a child protection bylaw as violence against children and HIV cases among adolescents increase.
  • A Bandung DPRD member criticized the city mayor for failing to firmly address PT BII's cable excavations disrupting the city.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The Indonesian military deployed 1,267 personnel for disaster response in East Nusa Tenggara following the major earthquake. The European Union offered to deploy its satellite systems to assist Indonesia in managing the NTT earthquake aftermath. Palestine expressed condolences to Indonesia over the earthquake disaster.

  • Crown Princess Victoria of Sweden will visit Indonesia in the coming period.
  • TNI forces operating in freezing conditions seized OPM-controlled territory in Intan Jaya and confiscated several weapons.
  • Indonesia and Pakistan's ambassadors discussed how both countries could potentially lead the global halal industry together.
  • Indonesia shipped 8.2 tons of Muntok white pepper to the Netherlands in an export transaction.

Other

A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck Nagekeo, East Nusa Tenggara, causing widespread devastation with the death toll reaching 47 people by evening. The government deployed Rp 4.5 billion in emergency aid, while President Prabowo sent 50,000 aid packages to affected areas. Multiple ports in Flores suffered damage from the earthquake, and a subsequent magnitude 6.2 tremor struck Parigi Moutong in Central Sulawesi.

  • The government is asking Apple and Google to remove the Hornet app from their platforms.
  • Indonesia plans to export 1,000 tons of premium rice to Malaysia as domestic production improves.
  • Garuda Indonesia launched new flight attendant uniforms rich in cultural motifs and reopened the Bali-Bandung route with jet aircraft returning to Husein Sastranegara airport.
  • The Nusantara capital city planted more than 2,000 trees in a single day, setting a national record for urban greening.
  • Indonesia launched a "flying doctor" program to bring medical services to remote regions across the archipelago.
